name: octen
description: Real-time web search, broad multi-angle search, URL extraction, and UI design references for coding agents, powered by Octen.

interface.shortDescription: Live web search, page extraction, and UI design references
interface.longDescription: Gives the agent live web information through Octen: real-time web search with highlights and filters, broad multi-angle search for research and comparisons, clean content extraction from URLs, and (invite-only beta) image search, video search, and curated UI design references with style tokens and HTML/CSS snippets. Requires an OCTEN_API_KEY from https://octen.ai; the beta skills additionally require beta access.
defaultPrompt: Use Octen to look up the latest news on this topic.
Use Octen to compare the main options and cite sources.
Use Octen to read this URL and summarize it.
